page.overview:
What is Biological Athletes Union?

The Biological Athletes Union was an organization active by 22 BBY. After the growth in popularity experienced by the Nuna-Ball League's matches of nuna-ball, a sport that involved teams of droids using a nuna creature as a ball and therefore required little sentient involvement other than that of repair technicians, the Biological Athletes Union, along with the Committee Against Non-Sentient Abuse, protested against the matches. Their objections, however, did not gain traction with the public, which was noted on the date 13:4:4 in an issue of the CoCo District Edition of the HoloNet News.

The Biological Athletes Union was first mentioned in HoloNet News Vol. 531 #50, an in-universe issue of the HoloNet News and published on the HoloNet News website on April 4, 2002.
